verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is a coding agent, so automatic cross-session memory is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no feature that builds or recalls memory across sessions. The closest item, /recap, only summarizes the current conversation on demand, which is a manual, in-session action rather than automatic persistent memory. The 'session renews itself' item is about sign-in authentication, not agent memory.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent build and recall memory automatically across sessions
